loss_formulation_comparison.executed_code_formula: for task, item in [(relation, x1), (mcqa, x2)]: loss_i = out.loss / 2; loss_i.backward()
loss_formulation_comparison.proof: Accumulated gradient is grad(0.5 * L_relation) + grad(0.5 * L_mcqa) = grad(0.5 * L_relation + 0.5 * L_mcqa). Mathematical objective is exact.
